newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka ends steady, recovers early loss.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka ends steady, recovers early loss.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka recovered from an early fall on Tuesday to close steady at 42.5150/5300 to the dollar after high call rates convinced banks to offload the greenback in the interbank market, dealers said.

The local unit was quoted weaker at 42.5250/5350 per dollar in early trade but edged up later despite a compratively larger purchase of dollars than in previous sessions. "Banks put attention to the call money market. There was almost panick buying (of call money) in early trade," said one dealer. The call money was traded at 8.0 to 9.0 percent, up from previous 7.5-8.5 percent.
